title: Bolden's band, Dusen and the Eagle Band
summary: He tells how Bolden blew across the park to Lincoln Park, lists Bolden's sidemen, and how Dusen took over as the Eagle Band, which he joined on violin.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Who was in the band when you heard him?

Did you know any of the guys? Well, I played with some of the men that he had after he died. I'll tell you how that come about. He had the bowling band. Now, he had a fella called Frank Lewis playing clarinet. And he had a rock mumpert on guitar. And he had a fella called Bob Lyons playing bass. And he was on trumpet. And I think it was D.D. Chandler, one of the old drummers was playing with him. And Cornish was playing trombone. That's the first band he had, see?
Do you want to stop and answer the phone?

No, that'll answer the town set. So, later on, a fella by the name of Frankie Dusen, a trombone player, he started playing with him, see? That's just before Bowling died, see? That's before he went and got sick, in other words. Well, after Bowling left out, then Frankie took the band over. This Dusen was a fella, the trombone player, and he called it the Eagle Band, see? Well, I played with the Eagle Band, with Dusen, because he's from over this side of the river, see? And he knew me as a kid, you know? Well, I played with some of the Bowling's old men in that band, see? Because Frankie kept the same fellas, but just him and I was different, you see?
You played the violin? Yeah, the violin.
Yeah, we played it out. We used to play at the old Masonic Hall there, you know, and play Scourge and Trips, and play all these dances and things around the town there, you know?

Well, a fella by the name of Edwild Clemmen, at that time. And then, later on, Bunk went with the Eagle Band, too. Now, the funny thing about Bunk, when he was with us downtown, the Superior Band, he didn't drink, he didn't have no bad habits at all. And when he went uptown with the Eagle Band, they ruined him. He started drinking and he went all the pieces, you know? Just ruined himself. It showed you a different environment, you understand? Mm-hmm.
